added_failure_derivation: The reviewed run's manifest has empty baseline_suite and after_suite fields and no completed paired suite logs; the set difference is unmeasured, so count is null rather than zero.

findings.text: blocking: classify assigns dropped_edge whenever historical evidence exists without enforcing the plan's no-live-holder condition; the committed results label 62 exhausted names dropped while recording an unrelated live holder for their source path, so the reported 222 endangered exhausted names conflate two populations.

blocking: any reachable successor with any producing edge qualifies an exhausted name as an orphan; no source identity is compared with the predecessor, and the sole orphan witness has no own recorded path, so the fixture and witness do not prove the successor holds the predecessor's sources.

follow-on: exhausted_source_location_counts and exhausted_dropped_edges are built from the same filtered rows, so this equality still passes if a dropped-edge row is omitted or misclassified and adds no independent regression protection.
